entities.summary: Doug MacLeod is an American storytelling blues musician and was the voice for the Blues Showcase of Continental Airlines. Doug MacLeod is a multiple Blues Music Awards winner, including the 2024 Blues Music Award for Acoustic Album Of The Year for his album Raw Blues 1 and 2023 the Blues Music Award for Acoustic Artist Of The Year. He received two 2026 Blues Music Award nominations for Acoustic Artist of the Year and Acoustic Album of the Year-Between Somewhere and Goodbye. Doug MacLeod is an international touring artist who writes and sings original songs that are based on his own life and experiences.
